title: culture-scrape ↔ pinakes canonical node/edge schema
description: The single canonical data contract both projects target. Node and edge column contracts mirror culture-scrape's typed Neo4j-import headers (packages/culture-scrape/src/culturescrape/schema/headers.py) so pinakes exports are import-compatible without transformation. See docs/canonical-schema.md for the prose specification and the per-lexicon mapping table.

idScheme.notes: csid is the primary key, unique across all nodes. When a Wikidata QID is known it is the identity (cs:<type>:Q12345); otherwise the local part is a readable slug plus a hash of normalized (name, lang). Minting is deterministic so re-runs are idempotent (see packages/culture-scrape/src/culturescrape/schema/ids.py).
idScheme.aliasNote: Every pinakes-origin row retains its original lexicon id in pinakes_id so the canonical→lexicon mapping survives round-trip (write-back).

nodeTypes.name: literary-tradition

nodeTypes.name: trade-good
nodeTypes.label: TradeGood

nodeTypes.name: battle
nodeTypes.label: Battle

nodeTypes.name: place
nodeTypes.label: Place

nodeTypes.name: migration-route
nodeTypes.label: MigrationRoute
nodeTypes.description: A route of human or cultural migration.

nodeTypes.name: asset
nodeTypes.label: Asset
nodeTypes.description: A content-addressed media asset (csid local part = sha256 of the file bytes), ingested from Analyzer's to_canonical projection. A personal-tier file node carrying technical properties (container/duration/codec/width/height, in overflow); the sha256: id-space of the predicate-mapping registry (v1.2 addition, analyzer-bridge US-003).

nodeTypes.name: character
nodeTypes.label: Character
nodeTypes.description: A person in a generated Insimul world (person/1 — first/last name, gender, birth year, occupation, alive flag). The canonical vocabulary's first person-family type; synthetic trust tier, world-scoped provenance (v1.3 addition, insimul-bridge US-003).

nodeTypes.name: building
nodeTypes.label: Building
nodeTypes.description: A built structure on a settlement lot in a generated Insimul world (lot/1, lot_building/2 — building type, address, occupants). Synthetic trust tier (v1.3 addition, insimul-bridge US-003).

nodeTypes.name: business
nodeTypes.label: Business
nodeTypes.description: A commercial establishment in a generated Insimul world (business/1, business_type/2 — owner, founder, founding year). Synthetic trust tier (v1.3 addition, insimul-bridge US-003).

edgeTypes.name: descended-from
edgeTypes.description: Genealogical descent (language→ancestor, culture→predecessor). Uses culture-scrape's existing DESCENDS_FROM token.

edgeTypes.name: split-from
edgeTypes.description: Diverged from a common ancestor.

edgeTypes.name: merged-with
edgeTypes.description: Merged with another lineage.

edgeTypes.name: influenced-by
edgeTypes.description: Received influence from another entity.

edgeTypes.name: conquered-by
edgeTypes.description: Militarily conquered by another polity.

edgeTypes.name: absorbed-into
edgeTypes.description: Absorbed into a successor culture/polity.

edgeTypes.name: spoken-in
edgeTypes.description: A language is spoken in a place.

edgeTypes.name: located-in
edgeTypes.description: An entity is located within a place.

edgeTypes.name: contemporary-with
edgeTypes.description: Overlapping time spans.

edgeTypes.name: part-of-period
edgeTypes.description: Falls within a named period.

edgeTypes.name: borrowed-from
edgeTypes.description: A term/word borrowed from a source language.

edgeTypes.name: cognate-with
edgeTypes.description: Terms sharing a common ancestral form.

edgeTypes.name: derived-from
edgeTypes.description: A cultural artifact/style/dish derived from an ancestor.

edgeTypes.name: syncretized-with
edgeTypes.description: Religious/deity syncretism between traditions.

edgeTypes.name: depicts
edgeTypes.description: An asset visually depicts an entity (Analyzer vision caption / detected object; the object may carry an entity_ref csid after Bridge-1 grounding). Personal tier (v1.2 addition, analyzer-bridge US-003).

edgeTypes.name: mentions
edgeTypes.description: An asset textually mentions an entity (Analyzer transcript / text ingest). Personal tier (v1.2 addition, analyzer-bridge US-003).

edgeTypes.name: parent-of
edgeTypes.description: Genealogical parenthood, canonical order (parent, child) — Insimul parent_of/2 (childIds); child_of/2 is the same relation with the arguments swapped, never a second edge. Synthetic tier (v1.3 addition, insimul-bridge US-003).

edgeTypes.name: spouse-of
edgeTypes.description: Marriage, symmetric — Insimul married_to/2 (spouseId); the two stored directions collapse to one edge with sorted endpoints. Synthetic tier (v1.3 addition, insimul-bridge US-003).

edgeTypes.name: employed-by
edgeTypes.description: A character works for a business — Insimul business_owner/2 / business_founder/2. Synthetic tier (v1.3 addition, insimul-bridge US-003).

edgeTypes.name: resides-in
edgeTypes.description: A character dwells in a building — Insimul residence_resident/2 / residence_owner/2. Occupancy, distinct from located-in (positional containment). Synthetic tier (v1.3 addition, insimul-bridge US-003).

edgeTypes.name: caused-by
edgeTypes.description: Event causality, canonical order (effect, cause) — Insimul truths' causesTruthIds/causedByTruthIds chains. Synthetic tier (v1.3 addition, insimul-bridge US-003).
